title: What the Wtp transition (invaren) is
body: Under the Future Pensions Act (Wet toekomst pensioenen, Wtp) the fund moves existing pension entitlements into the new pension contract. This conversion is called invaren. The fund's administrator calculates every member's figures with its actuarial systems. The statutory transition period ends on 1 January 2028.

title: For pensioners: your payment on the transition date
body: If you already receive a pension, the transition is designed so that your gross monthly payment directly after the transition is the amount shown in your personal transition letter. The official amount always comes from the administrator's calculation.

title: After the transition: yearly adjustments
body: In the new contract, pensions can be adjusted each year depending on the fund's investment results and the agreed solidarity reserve. Adjustments can be upward or downward. Your yearly statement shows the official adjustment.

title: What changes and what stays the same
body: Stays the same: the fund pays your pension, payment dates and your accrued entitlements are converted, not lost. Changes: the way pensions are adjusted each year and, for active members, the personal pension capital presentation.

title: How to raise a question or an objection
body: You can ask the fund a question or submit an objection using the procedure described in your transition letter. A human advisor can help you with the process. The AI assistant cannot decide on objections.

title: Talking to a human advisor
body: You can always ask to speak with a person. The fund's advisors can schedule a call. Personal advice about choices is given only by licensed human advisors.

title: Personal pension capital
body: For members who are still building up pension, the new contract shows a personal pension capital. It is the administrator's official conversion of your accrued entitlements and is shown in your transition letter.

title: Wat de overgang (invaren) inhoudt
body: Onder de Wet toekomst pensioenen (Wtp) brengt het fonds bestaande pensioenaanspraken over naar de nieuwe pensioenregeling. Dit heet invaren. De uitvoeringsorganisatie berekent de bedragen van ieder deelnemer.

title: Voor gepensioneerden: uw uitkering op de overgangsdatum
body: Als u al pensioen ontvangt, is uw bruto maandelijkse uitkering direct na de overgang het bedrag in uw persoonlijke overgangsbrief. Het officiële bedrag komt altijd uit de berekening van de uitvoeringsorganisatie.
